searchText: Is it just me or does blocks per a day seem to be trending down? https://www.etherchain.org/charts/blocksPerDay Could be the first signs of the ice age. will eip-4488/90 make rollups less impacted by fee spikes on L1? For example optimism has costed like $14 to make a ETH transfer when there was high basefee on L1. But will 4488/90 make the spikes less impactful on L2 ? encouraging more users to use rollups with protocol level subsidies ala EIP4488/90 seems reckless. Why not wait a year or two until they are more mature? Some of the most popular rollups dont even seem to have fraudproofs ready or any escape hatch mechanisms yet. Lets try and avoid another TheDAO? 😛 according to watchtheburn.com fees have been slowly trending down since late october so its possible fees wont be an issue in a few months anyway
